Historic English Mansion Barlborough Hall Up for Auction

Barlborough Hall, a 440-year-old Grade I-listed Elizabethan mansion dating to 1583, is scheduled for auction. Located near Chesterfield, the historic property spans nearly 16,000 square feet and includes 14 acres of grounds. The mansion has been linked to Sir Francis Rodes. The auction's guide price is set between £550,000 and £600,000.
